test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, which of the following is NOT recognised as a national party?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Samajwadi Party**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Samajwadi Party was founded on **October 4, 1992, by Mulayam Singh Yadav** in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• The party's electoral symbol is a **bicycle,** which represents progress and movement.
 
• **Mulayam Singh Yadav **served as the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh from February 1993 to May 1995.
 
• The Samajwadi Party has a youth wing called the **Samajwadi Yuvjan Sabha**, focusing on engaging younger voters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Communist Party **of India was founded on **December 26, 1925**, in Kanpur, India.
 
• The CPI's electoral **symbol is a hammer and sickle**, representing the unity of workers and peasants.
 
• The** Bahujan Samaj Party** was founded on **April 14, 1984, by Kanshi Ram** in India.
 
• The party's electoral **symbol is the elephant,** representing strength and stability.
 
• The **Indian National Congress **was founded on **December 28, 1885, in Bombay** (now Mumbai).
 
• The electoral symbol of the Congress party is the** hand,** which signifies unity and the people's power.
